name: Dollar on Chain
oneLiner: DOC is Money On Chain's overcollateralized USD stablecoin on Rootstock, minted against rBTC vaults with permissionless DOC-for-rBTC redemption.
collateral: rBTC locked in Money On Chain smart contracts on Rootstock
pegMechanism: DOC targets 1 USD through overcollateralized rBTC backing, protocol incentives, and permissionless DOC-to-rBTC redemption through the Money On Chain dApp

mintAuthority.summary: DOC is minted permissionlessly against rBTC locked in Money On Chain's overcollateralized contracts on Rootstock, with permissionless DOC-for-rBTC redemption. The DoCToken is Ownable and its owner is the MoCExchange proxy, which is the only direct minter. MoCExchange is a zeppelinOS transparent proxy whose admin is the published Admin contract, owned by the Upgrade Delegator, which is governed by the Money On Chain Governor. The Governor authorizes Changer contracts and can therefore upgrade mint-critical logic, so the mint bound is governance-revocable rather than immutable. The Governor's own owner is an on-chain changer-authorizing contract; the off-chain keyholder set behind that contract is not publicly enumerable, which is why the posture is partially-bounded rather than bounded.

controls.capDescription: Mint is bounded by the protocol's rBTC overcollateralization: DOC is issued only against locked rBTC and is permissionlessly redeemable for rBTC. MoCExchange cannot raise that bound itself; only a Governor-authorized Changer can alter the parameters.

controls.evidence: At Rootstock block 9051085: DoCToken 0xe700691d owner() = 0x6acb83bb0281fb847b43cf7dd5e2766bfdf49038, which Money On Chain's published contract list names MoCExchange. The DoCToken itself is not a proxy (EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots and the zeppelinOS slots all read zero), so the token's mint logic can only change by changing its owner contract or by upgrading MoCExchange. Reported DoCToken totalSupply at that block was 2,935,279.125 DOC.

controls.evidence: At Rootstock block 9051085 the MoCExchange proxy's zeppelinOS admin slot (keccak256('org.zeppelinos.proxy.admin') = 0x10d6a54a...) reads 0x009c51e1f6fedcdb8014ea9ae1e39b6dbf2ac0ec (the published Admin contract); Admin.owner() = 0x5ce577f6ec969ce9a282838d350206c52a6f338c (the published Upgrade Delegator); UpgradeDelegator.governor() = 0x3b8853df65afbd94853e6d77ee0ab5590f41bb08 (the published Governor). The Governor exposes isAuthorizedChanger(address), i.e. it authorizes the Changer contracts that execute upgrades and parameter changes, so it can raise or remove the collateral-derived mint bound and can replace mint logic. CORRECTION to the 2026-06-11 review: 0x7050c9e0f4ca769c69bd3a8ef740bc37934f8e2c036e5a723fd8ee048ed3f8c3 is keccak256('org.zeppelinos.proxy.implementation'), not a governor slot, so the address previously recorded as the Governor (0x36d1dc7b) was the MoCExchange implementation at that time; that slot now reads 0x9bfbbdb1bf118e15249bb70460a1f4886511b53c.

controls.label: Money On Chain Governor owner (changer-authorizing contract)

sources.label: Rootstock explorer: Money On Chain Governor 0x3b8853df
Rootstock public RPC node (eth_call / eth_getStorageAt reads)

controls.evidence: At Rootstock block 9051085, Governor.owner() = 0x65a5681be95d212f0c90ead40170d8277de81169, a contract (2,240 bytes) that is itself Governed (its governor() returns the Governor 0x3b8853df). It is the root authority that can drive the Governor's change authorization and is therefore the effective upgrade root. Money On Chain's published contract list does not name this contract, and its off-chain keyholder or signer set is not enumerable from public RPC, so its internal quorum is not claimed here; its on-chain identity is nevertheless fully resolved.

review.evidence: Full authority graph re-derived on-chain at Rootstock block 9051085 (2026-07-14) via eth_call and eth_getStorageAt on https://public-node.rsk.co, then cross-checked against Money On Chain's published mainnet contract list: DoCToken 0xe700691d (not a proxy; owner() = MoCExchange 0x6acb83bb) -> MoCExchange transparent proxy (zeppelinOS implementation slot = 0x9bfbbdb1, admin slot = Admin 0x009c51e1) -> Admin.owner() = Upgrade Delegator 0x5ce577f6 -> UpgradeDelegator.governor() = Governor 0x3b8853df -> Governor.owner() = 0x65a5681b. Every address in that chain is a contract and every hop was read at the cited block. The published contract list independently names the Governor, Upgrade Delegator, Admin, MoCExchange, and DoCToken at exactly these addresses. This review corrects the 2026-06-11 entry, which read the zeppelinOS implementation slot and recorded its value (0x36d1dc7b) as the Governor. Remaining limitation, recorded rather than resolved: the Governor's owner contract is identified on-chain but its off-chain signer set is not publicly enumerable, so the authority posture stays partially-bounded.
